title: still present since round 3: Vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally - nonexistent ids report success; the Result error channel is dead
evidence:
#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))
(archive_vacancy:1245, restore_vacancy:1259, close_vacancy:1273 — all identical) and change_status:1345:
  #(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))
The list.map no-ops when no vacancy/application id matches, yet Ok is returned; update_vacancy/publish_vacancy (which use find_vacancy |> result.map) are the only mutations that can return Error.
detail: Callers cannot distinguish a miss from a mutation; the deliver_err path in demo_api.respond_result is unreachable for these four mutations.
recommended_fix: Check the match after the map and return Error(Nil) on miss, or drop the Result and simplify the call chain.

title: still present since round 3: mark_opened doc claims an idempotent Submitted->UnderReview transition but applies it to any status
detail: An 'open' on an already-shortlisted/rejected application would regress it to UnderReview; idempotency rests entirely on the dispatch-layer open_dispatched set.
recommended_fix: Transition only when the current status is Submitted; otherwise leave the store unchanged.

title: still present since round 3: create_vacancy derives the id from an 8-char-truncated name slug with no uniqueness check
detail: Two demo-created vacancies named e.g. 'Riverside Apartments A' and 'Riverside Apartments B' both get id v-demo-riverside; the first silently vanishes from lookups.
recommended_fix: Append a disambiguator (sequence or count of existing v-demo- ids) or extend the suffix until unique.

title: still present since round 3: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts that contradict the seeded awaiting list
detail: The demo teaches an outcome that never happened: canned reminder/invite counts ignore both the typed input and the seeded awaiting state.
recommended_fix: Parse the submitted emails, compute the result from actual input, and flip reminded/followed_up in static_awaiting-backed state (or drop the fake mutation and honest-count from the seeded rows).

title: Demo 'mark all read' leaves the badge and dropdown rows stale — the demo arm drops the real arm's optimistic model update and the Ok response handler is a no-op
detail: After the bell shows 2 unread (seeded notifications), clicking 'Mark all read' in demo leaves the badge at 2 and rows unread until the dropdown is reopened and refetches — diverges from the real dashboard the lavish verdict requires the demo to match.
recommended_fix: Mirror the real arm's optimistic update (set notifications all-read + unread_count: 0) in the demo UserClickedMarkAllRead arm, and extend the pin to a model that starts with unread_count 2.

title: still present since round 3: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention - ids can collide and one timeout dismisses both
evidence:
let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1
  ...
      next_toast_id: toast_id,
(demo_update.gleam:638,646) vs add_toast (client.gleam:7115,7128):
  let id = model.next_toast_id
  ...
  #(Model(..model, toasts: capped_toasts, next_toast_id: id + 1), dismiss_eff)
The demo helper allocates id N+1 and leaves next_toast_id at N+1, so the next add_toast re-allocates N+1 while the demo toast (5s timeout, AppDismissToast(N+1)) is still live.
detail: Two live toasts share one id; the demo toast's timeout dismisses the unrelated toast with the same id.
recommended_fix: Reuse add_toast's allocation (id = next_toast_id, then increment) or route demo toasts through add_toast.

title: still present since round 3: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
detail: The page parameter is discarded; if a vacancy ever exceeds one page of fixture data the demo would duplicate the whole list on load-more.
recommended_fix: Slice by page or drop the parameter.

title: still present since round 3: zero-caller export demo_store.notifications shipped
detail: Exported surface with no caller; the notification surfaces consume notifications_unread.

title: still present since round 3: status_from_slug silently coerces any unknown status slug to Submitted
detail: A typo in a demo action wire (set_status/change_status caller) silently lands as Submitted instead of failing loudly, and change_status returns Ok(slug) regardless.
recommended_fix: Return a Result or panic on unknown slugs in the demo store.

title: still present since round 3 (partial): download_timeout duplicated with divergent signature between demo_update and client.gleam (store_of half consolidated)
detail: Two near-identical timeout helpers with different signatures; a change to one (e.g. the timeout duration) silently misses the other.
recommended_fix: Lift download_timeout to a shared demo helper module (or call client.gleam's with 90_000).

title: add_days_iso/roll_forward produce a malformed closes_at for negative validity_days, reachable via the unvalidated draft path
detail: Typing a negative number into the validity field and saving as draft in the demo creates a vacancy with a malformed closes_at string; days_between then parses garbage into an absurd days_remaining.
recommended_fix: Clamp days to >= 0 in add_days_iso (or treat day <= 0 by rolling backward), or validate validity_days on the draft path too.
